USER:
JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION:
Mary Meyer
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0118 | mary.meyer@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Reporting analyst with a mix of roles across property management, medical billing, freight and online retail, none longer than about two and a half years. Writes basic SQL, keeps Tableau dashboards and Excel reports running on schedule, and has spent the last couple of years working with ecommerce order and inventory data for a pet supply retailer. Picks up new source systems quickly.

EXPERIENCE
Reporting Analyst | Pawsmith Pet Supply, Columbus, OH | Feb 2024 to Present
• Refresh and maintain weekly Tableau dashboards on online orders, returns and inventory on hand for the merchandising and fulfillment teams, most originally set up by a previous analyst.
• Pull data from PostgreSQL for buyers who ask about sell-through and out of stocks, mostly with saved queries adjusted for dates and categories.
• Send buyers a daily Excel list of top items running low on stock, filtered from the inventory export.
• Helped reconcile order counts between the web platform and the warehouse system after the fulfillment manager noticed a gap.
• Pulled sales for a free shipping promotion and the same weeks a year earlier so the marketing manager could judge whether it paid off.
• Keep the request log in Jira up to date and note which reports each team relies on.

Reporting Associate (contract to hire) | Kestrel Freight Systems, Columbus, OH | Sep 2021 to Jan 2024
• Produced on-time delivery and cost per mile reports for 12 shipper accounts in Excel, with a few later moved to Tableau.
• Ran SQL Server queries written by the reporting lead to combine shipment, carrier and invoice data each month.
• Updated the carrier scorecard used in quarterly business reviews with the three largest customers.
• Cleaned duplicate carrier records in the transportation management system, merging about 300 entries.
• Answered account manager questions about late loads and accessorial charges by looking up shipment records.
• Converted from contract to full time in 2022.

Reporting Specialist | Bexford Medical Billing, Columbus, OH | Feb 2020 to Aug 2021
• Ran weekly accounts receivable aging and denial reports for 20 physician practice clients.
• Built Excel templates with pivot tables and lookups that shortened monthly client report prep.
• Started learning SQL on the job to pull claim and payment data from the billing database.
• Noticed a payer whose denial rate had jumped and raised it with the billing supervisor.
• Mailed and emailed monthly statements to practice managers and logged follow-up questions.

Data Coordinator | Hartvell Property Group, Columbus, OH | Jul 2018 to Jan 2020
• Maintained unit, lease and work order data for 2,400 apartment units in Yardi.
• Produced monthly occupancy and delinquency reports in Excel for property managers.
• Audited lease records before a software upgrade and corrected about 350 records with missing or wrong move-in dates.
• Answered resident account questions forwarded by the leasing office.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2018

SKILLS
Querying: SQL (PostgreSQL, SQL Server), SELECT, joins, filters and grouped totals
Reporting: Tableau Desktop (maintaining existing dashboards), Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP), Google Sheets
Systems: Yardi, McLeod TMS, Shopify admin reports, Jira for request tracking

ADDITIONAL
• Volunteer tutor for a Columbus adult literacy program, helping learners practice basic computer skills twice a month
